root_cause.text: The nfsd4_add_rdaccess_to_wrdeleg() function overwrites an existing fi_fds[O_RDONLY] pointer without releasing its reference and stores a single nfsd_file reference in both fi_fds[O_RDONLY] and fi_rdeleg_file, causing a reference leak that is never fully released when the delegation is put due to the access count not dropping to zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check in nfsd4_add_rdaccess_to_wrdeleg() to not overwrite an already set fi_fds[O_RDONLY] and uses nfsd_file_get() for the delegation pointer, plus adds nfsd_file_put(rnf) in put_deleg_file() before nfs4_file_put_access(). The CVE description explicitly states the unconditional overwrite and the single-reference issue leading to leaks and a BUG on cache destruction.
